description: This Java source file defines the BluetoothChatFragment class, which manages Bluetooth communication and UI interactions for a chat feature in an Android application. It handles Bluetooth setup, device connection, message sending and receiving, and UI updates within a Fragment.

classes.name: BluetoothChatFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that manages Bluetooth chat, including connection setup, message exchange, and UI management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, checking for Bluetooth support.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Ensures Bluetooth is enabled or requests enabling it; sets up chat if ready.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops Bluetooth chat service if active.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth service if it is stopped.

methods.name: setupChat
methods.description: Sets up the chat UI and Bluetooth service.

methods.name: ensureDiscoverable
methods.description: Makes the device discoverable via Bluetooth.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles activity results related to Bluetooth device selection and enabling Bluetooth.

methods.name: connectDevice
methods.description: Establishes a Bluetooth connection to a device.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for connecting or making device discoverable.
